title: QA Report
description: The release gate verdict from QA Agent (A28) for one artifact at one revision. Three verdicts and no fourth. A verdict of 'pass' means cleared FOR human approval, never approved: a human is always the last gate before anything customer-facing (/AGENTS.md). Layer 1 (compliance) is adjudicated by A30 Compliance/Risk and A28 cannot overrule or downgrade its blocking findings.

target_id.description: MC-xxxx, CC-xxxx, or the RP-xxxx whose channel assets were checked.

brief_id.description: The acceptance baseline. Null only on a brief_unavailable failure, which is itself a fail verdict.

layer_results.description: One entry per layer, in gate order. A skipped layer is recorded with its reason and never silently omitted: a short report must not be readable as a clean one.

adjudicated_by.description: compliance layer is always adjudicated by compliance_risk (A30).

verdict.description: pass = zero blocking findings and no open A30 blocking finding; proceeds to human approval. pass_with_conditions = named major fixes must be made and re-verified first. fail = returns to the owning agent. There is no partial pass.

conditions.description: Required non-empty when verdict is pass_with_conditions: the specific fixes that must be made and re-verified.

a30_verdict.description: The delegated compliance verdict. A28 enforces it verbatim and cannot overrule, downgrade, or pass around it.

technical_issue_ids.description: Emitted using agents/seo/schemas/technical_issue.schema.json so Codex receives one format regardless of which agent found the problem. Each carries acceptance criteria and a verification method.

human_approval_required.description: Always true. A28 never approves; it clears an artifact FOR human approval.

approval_note.const: QA has cleared this artifact for your consideration. It is NOT approved. Publication requires your explicit approval.
approval_note.description: Fixed text so the approval boundary cannot be lost when the report is read out of context.

recheck_scope.description: A fixed blocking finding requires a full re-run: fixes in one layer routinely break another.

repeat_findings.description: Finding ids recurring across revisions. A third occurrence escalates as a process problem.

immediate.description: published_compliance_risk and unverified_photo_permission on a live page go to the human immediately, with a recommendation to unpublish.

checked_against_source_material.description: True only when layer 3 could actually open every referenced source record. False with a firsthand layer status of passed is a contradiction and is itself a defect.
